blurb: Guests can take riding lessons in English or Western styles, participate in various horse camps for different age groups, enjoy guided trail rides, and join pony programs designed for young children. The farm offers year-round indoor lessons and seasonal camps with a focus on safety and horsemanship. Special programs are available for Girl Scouts and Boy Scouts, as well as adult retreats and camps.

checkin: Thank you for booking a ride with Lang's Horse and Pony Farm. We look forward to seeing you! All participants must sign a waiver before attending. If you're booking on behalf of others, please ensure you share the waiver link with them so they can complete it in advance. Please give us a call at 360-424-7630 with any questions or concerns.
cancellation: All reservations are charged in full at the time of booking. We accept cancellations up to 48 hours before your scheduled ride time. Any cancellations made within the 48 hours before your ride will result in a charge for the full amount of your reservation. Weather cancellations are at the sole discretion of Lang's Horse & Pony Farm. We will ride as long as it will be safe and enjoyable.
